nodes.title: 🔀 Bypassers & Mute

en.text:
Turn whole parts of a workflow on and off from one place. ✋ Use these instead of bypassing nodes by hand.

**LC Bypasser**
- Bypasses linked nodes from one place with toggles or BOOLEAN inputs.

**LC Mute**
- Works like LC Bypasser, but Off mutes the linked nodes instead of bypassing them.

**LC Groups Bypasser**
- Bypasses whole groups from one place, with one toggle per group.

**LC Bypasser Panel**
- A widgets-only remote for LC Bypasser, LC Mute or LC Groups Bypasser.

**LC Bypass Relay**
- Gathers nodes on its left so a hub can mute or bypass all of them together through OPT_CONNECTION.

nodes.title: ✅ Booleans

en.text:
True / false and everything you do with it.

**LC Boolean Value**
- A plain boolean toggle you can wire anywhere.

**LC Boolean**
- Turns a boolean, int or float into a clean true/false and shows it on the node.

**LC Boolean Flip**
- Outputs the opposite of its toggle.

**LC Invert Boolean**
- Coerces a boolean, int or float and outputs the opposite.

**LC Boolean Switch**
- Picks the on_true or on_false input (any type) based on a boolean.

**LC 🚦**
- A light for a boolean: one color for true, one for false (or none). Colors behind the gear.

**LC Is Bypassed / Muted**
- Outputs true if the node wired into it is bypassed or muted, read live without queuing.

nodes.title: 🔁 Switches

en.text:
Pick one of several inputs, or test whether something is empty.

**LC AnySwitch**
- Picks the first connected input out of 2 to 20 and locks to its type.

**LC Any Index Switch**
- Passes through the input at the chosen index and ignores the other slots.

**LC Any Empty Bool**
- Outputs true if any connected input is empty, muted or bypassed.

**LC Any Empty Int**
- Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty integer.

**LC Any Empty Float**
- Runs the same empty test as Any Empty Bool and outputs an empty and a not-empty float.

nodes.title: 🔢 Numbers & Choices

en.text:
Sliders, compares and dropdowns you can wire anywhere.

**LC Slider**
- A slider on the node face that outputs an int or float.

**LC Control Panel 🎛️**
- Up to 16 sliders on one node, each on its own output. The gear on a row sets its name, range, step and INT or FLOAT. A new row plugged into a number input copies that input's settings.

**LC Int Compare**
- Outputs the larger or smaller of two integers.

**LC Float Compare**
- Outputs the larger or smaller of two floats.

**LC Int Split**
- Splits a total into a + b at a fractional split point, so a + b always equals the total.

**LC Combo Selector**
- A dropdown that mirrors the options of another node's combo (sampler, scheduler, etc.) when wired into it.

**LC Custom Combo**
- Builds your own list of options and outputs the chosen text and its index.

**LC Custom Combo Panel**
- A remote control that picks the choice for an LC Custom Combo from another spot.

nodes.title: 🛑 Flow Control

en.text:
Pause, pass through, time and clean up a run.

**LC Stop 🛑**
- A queue breakpoint you can enable to pause until you continue.

**LC Image Pass**
- Passes an image straight through, and its enable switch mutes what hangs off it downstream.

**LC Mask Pass**
- Passes a mask through, and turning it off makes downstream nodes run with no mask (full frame).

**LC VRAM Cache Clear**
- A pass-through node that clears GPU and model cache when it runs, also on its own branch with nothing after it.

**LC Timer ⏱️**
- Times every run and scores the newest one against the 5 before it: faster in green, slower in red. Stopped and fully cached runs are left out.

**LC Notify 🔊**
- Plays a chosen sound when the node runs (always, on empty queue, or never).

nodes.title: About this workflow 👋

en.text:
# LC123 Examples - Logic & Switches

Bypassers, booleans, switches and the little number tools that make a workflow run itself.

- These are examples of every node in each section, with a short note on what it does. They are not wired: drop the ones you need into your own workflow.
- 💡 Hover any input for its tooltip. Full details in the [README](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes).

**In this workflow:**
- 🔀 Bypassers & Mute
- ✅ Booleans
- 🔁 Switches
- 🔢 Numbers & Choices
- 🛑 Flow Control
